Name: Kzinti's Image Adjustments
Author: kzintiwife
Description:
So I am colorblind and find many of the in color textures hard to see. I have recolored some to make them more noticeable. Each of these are configurable and can be turned off or on during game play using the generic menu mod. 

1. The crab pots, I could never tell if they have bait. Most of the recolors i have seen also make them a pink in color, so i am never sure if the bait was actually put in. As someone who fishes in real life, some bait is pink, but some is bright crazy green.

2. The brown arrow that points at things like the forage items and dig spots, was very hard for me to see. I made this in a high contrast color combo that will not blend into the backgrounds of the standard colored map (black and fuchsia)

3. The dig spots are nearly impossible for me to find. When the little arrow disappears I cannot tell where the dig spots are. This gives a nice circle for the artifact dig spots and a colorful x for the seed dig spots.

4. I was never sure if I got all of the things filled. This changes the colors of the bubbles over casks, jars, and kegs.

5. I thought it would be fun to be able to tell which of the rocks would give you exp before you spend all your energy clearing out all the rocks. They are colored pink and green to standout in all the cave levels.

Thanks for looking!

Manifest.Name: Kzinti's Image Adjustments
Manifest.Description: easier to see - locater, digspots, specialty rocks, crabpots, and bubbles. All are configurable for on or off.
